title: Settings-row NOC dismissal clears overlay_on but never calls view_set_rail — play_w stays shrunk with the rail hidden
detail: Every other overlay_on flip re-syncs play_w via view_set_rail; this path does not. After dismissing via the settings row, play_w stays win_w − NOC_RAIL_W while no rail draws: camera_fit shrinks the world ~21%, camera_update centers it left of a phantom 524px rail, and mode label/crisis banner/audio caption/settings modal all mis-anchor — breaking the diff's own 'play_w == win_w when the overlay is off' invariant. The D key is dead while noc_enabled is false, so only a window resize or a re-enable + D-cycle recovers.
recommended_fix: Add rnd.view_set_rail(&app.view, false) inside the `if !app.noc_enabled { app.overlay_on = false }` branch, and extend noc_disable_while_visible_dismisses_the_panel to assert app.view.play_w == app.view.win_w after dismissal.
